description: Audit canonical and robots directives across a set of supplied pages together. Reports a canonical chain, where one page names another that names a third and crawlers do not follow reliably; pages consolidating onto a target that declares noindex; a page declaring noindex while naming itself canonical; an X-Robots-Tag header disagreeing with the markup, where which one wins is not under the page author control; a canonical crossing hosts; and pages with none at all. Nothing is fetched. Pay 110000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

pages.description: Up to 50 pages, each with the URL it was served under and its HTML. Nothing is fetched: the caller supplies the bytes, which is what lets an arbitrary site be audited.

headers.description: Response headers for this page, if available. Names are compared case-insensitively, as HTTP defines them. A repeated header may be an array or a comma-joined string. A header that is absent is omitted; a null value is refused rather than read as present. At most 200 entries.

html.description: This page. Raw HTML, at most 262144 bytes. Scripts are not executed, so anything rendered client-side is absent and said to be absent. Nothing is fetched: the caller supplies the bytes, which is what lets an arbitrary site be audited.

url.description: The URL this page was served under. Used to resolve relative links and to compare against the declared canonical. A wrong value produces wrong resolutions rather than silently relative ones.

robots_txt.description: The robots.txt contents, if available, so site-level directives can be read alongside the page-level ones. Absent means that comparison is reported as not done.

name: canonical_robots_consistency_audit

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of it was not, which is a different problem from something that is wrong.

consistent.description: True only when every page parsed, every canonical resolved sensibly, and no directive contradicted another.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

pages.description: Per page: its canonical, the markup robots directive, the header directive and whether either says noindex.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

title: Canonical and Robots Consistency Audit
